scope: All distributed package files except the introductory README.md and this manifest. File entries describe publication bytes, not a new runtime qualification.

digest_semantics.sha256: SHA-256 of the current public file bytes.
digest_semantics.historical_selection_sha256: SHA-256 of the same path in the preserved 2026-09-09 publication selection, present only when those bytes differ. These are historical identities, not hashes of the current public copy.
digest_semantics.unchanged_files: When historical_selection_sha256 is absent, the public bytes match the preserved selection unless historical_selection explicitly states otherwise.
digest_semantics.historical_evidence: Original evidence identities retained from the source provenance records. A digest-only record is not a downloadable file; RESULTS.json is a curated summary, not the full original evidence.
digest_semantics.embedded_run_digests: SOURCE_DIGEST files and recorded source/binary identifiers belong to historical runs or ancestors. Use the per-file hashes below to identify this distribution.
